dct_description_sm: Relates vegetation type and trail type to recovery progress. The results demonstrate how vegetation type and trail type influence the level of impacts, and how recovery progresses over time. The study will compare impacts to the tundra and tundra vegetation recovery to sites elsewhere on the North Slope. Soils (active layer) and vegetation measurements.
dct_title_s: Impact of Seismic Trails, Camp Trails and Ice Road on Tundra Vegetation in the Northeast National Petroleum Reserve - Alaska
